summary: The study describes the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of platinum (Pt) on yttria-stabilized zirconia (YSZ) substrates using methylcyclopentadienyltrimethylplatinum (MeCpPtMe3) and oxygen as precursors. The process is used to create patterned Pt films through area-selective ALD by using microcontact printed self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) of octadecyltrichlorosilane (ODTS) to block the deposition on specific regions. The Pt films exhibit low resistivity and high purity, and the study demonstrates the effectiveness of ODTS SAMs in achieving selective deposition.
